_comment: Musiques de fond originales générées avec Lyria 2 (Vertex AI). Chaque morceau = plusieurs extraits de 30 s (une graine chacun) enchaînés en fondu au mixage. Même tonalité et tempo dans le prompt pour que les extraits se raccordent.
negative_prompt: vocals, singing, choir, spoken word, lyrics, loud drums, heavy bass drops, distorted guitar, abrupt changes, harsh high frequencies, lo-fi noise

nightdrive.prompt: Instrumental background underscore for a business documentary voice-over. Sleek, modern and premium. Warm analog synth pads, soft pulsing arpeggiated synth, deep sub bass, subtle airy textures. Sparse, no lead melody, steady and calm, cinematic. D minor, 92 BPM.

boardroom.prompt: Instrumental background underscore for a business documentary voice-over. Elegant and thoughtful. Soft felt piano notes, sustained warm strings, gentle electronic textures, light ticking percussion. Sparse, no lead melody, restrained, cinematic. A minor, 84 BPM.

circuit.prompt: Instrumental background underscore for a technology documentary voice-over. Clean and curious. Plucked synths, glassy bell tones, light minimal electronic percussion, soft kick, warm pads. Sparse, no lead melody, steady pulse, polished. F minor, 100 BPM.

horizon.prompt: Instrumental background underscore for a documentary voice-over. Ambient orchestral, slowly evolving deep warm pads, soft low strings, distant brass swells, subtle shimmer. Sparse, no lead melody, contemplative and inspiring but restrained. C minor, 72 BPM.
